## Review

**7 out of 10, Effective.** Presentation quality, judged with the SlideDeck Co review heuristic (https://slidedeck.co/review-methodology/). The ask, the evidence and the merit of the idea are not rated.

The deck has a clear route: agenda, section dividers, a three-part framing (diversified, consistent, positioned for the future) that is restated in takeaways on slides 37 and 71, and a CFO section that builds from fee-bearing capital to fee-related earnings to distributable earnings in slides 62 to 67. Individual pages are clean and legible, with strong hierarchy on slides 4, 24 and 46, consistent navy and green identity, and a sensible sentence-style title chain. Weaknesses are consequential: many pages are near-empty dividers or three-icon placeholders (slides 8, 9, 18, 30, 31, 36, 45, 50, 55, 61), the sunburst on slides 14 to 16 shrinks to unreadable text, and footnotes and the page footer are tiny. Some charts have an uneven axis or crowded labelling (slide 47 has two scales sharing one chart, slide 26 has very small labels), which leaves a competent but not exceptional deck.

**Worth keeping:** Keep the slide 4 headline-number layout, the slide 24 table with bolded actuals, the slide 46 stacked bars with a record callout, and the CFO bridge from capital to earnings to dividend on slides 62 to 68.

**Most useful repair:** Enlarge or simplify the sunburst on slides 15 and 16 and the sub-sector labels, and fold the near-empty divider and icon-only pages into content slides that carry a claim.

**What would change the score:** I would cut the repeated dividers and the 'Increasingly diversified' echo on slides 8 and 9, and raise the footnote and chart label sizes so small text on slides 26, 47 and 60 is readable.

## Summary

The deck is an investor day presentation from Brookfield Asset Management, dated to mid-2026 based on data as of June 30, 2026. It opens with a title slide and an agenda listing speakers including the CEO, CFO, and the Co-CEO of Credit, followed by a section titled The Brookfield Advantage. The middle sections cover the firm's business mix across five groups, its consistency of performance, its positioning for future trends, and its growth model. The CFO section explains the company's structure and projects fee-bearing capital, fee-related earnings and distributable earnings through 2031. A credit section then covers the platform after the Oaktree integration, the market environment, and the main growth areas. The deck closes with key takeaways, a CEO panel slide, and endnotes and notices. Worth studying: slide 4, which packs headline capital figures for each business group into one view; slide 24, a table comparing target and actual returns across strategies; slide 46, a bar chart with a record-year callout; and slide 91, which uses a simple Treasury yield line to frame the credit market shift.

## Questions about this deck

**What does the Brookfield Asset Management investor day deck say about fee-bearing capital?**

Slide 4 shows $672 Billion in Fee-Bearing Capital, split as Infrastructure $114B, Energy $74B, Private Equity $54B, Real Estate $104B and Credit $326B.

**How much fundraising does the Brookfield Asset Management investor day deck report?**

Slide 6 shows Fundraising of $97 for Q2 '25 LTM and $163 for Q2 '26 LTM, a +70% change. Slide 46 states $163B raised over the last 12 months and labels a Record Year.

**What returns does the Brookfield Asset Management investor day deck show for its strategies?**

Slide 24 compares target and actual returns, and for Infrastructure (16 years) it shows a gross target of 13% against an actual of 15%, and a net target of 11% against an actual of 12%.

**How many slides does the Brookfield Asset Management investor day deck have and how is it organized?**

The deck has 114 pages. Slide 2 lists the agenda, with Connor Teskey as CEO at 12:50 PM, Hadley Peer Marshall as CFO at 1:10 PM and Bob O'Leary as Co-CEO of Credit at 1:35 PM.

Five single-weight line icons, one per column, all drawn in navy #002540 with blue #3E9AD6 accents. (2) Energy: a navy vertical mast on a short base, with a blue three-bladed wind turbine head shaped like a pinwheel. (3) Private Equity: a navy outlined battery with two small terminal tabs on top, with a blue minus sign and a blue plus sign inside the body. (4) Real Estate: a navy outlined tall building with a grid of blue-outlined square windows (3 by 3), beside a shorter navy outlined annex with two blue square windows in one column. (5) Credit: a navy outline of an oak leaf with a diagonal midrib line running from the lower left to the upper right. Icons are centred in their columns and are about 9% of slide height tall. The icons are not cropped and have no overlay. A thin navy rectangular frame with 1 px lines and sharp corners encloses the five columns, and thin navy vertical rules divide them.

Starting at the top and moving clockwise: a light grey arc (#D9D7D1) at top-left, ending in an arrowhead pointing right at the top; a pale green arc (#ADD2AD) at top-right, with an arrowhead pointing down-right; a dark green arc (#237239) at right, with an arrowhead pointing down-left; a bright green arc (#26A049) at bottom, with an arrowhead pointing left; and a navy arc (#002F4A) at left, with an arrowhead pointing up-right into the grey arc. The ring has a hollow centre with no content. Each arc is a solid filled block arrow with no outline. Five line icons, each in dark navy (#002540) stroke about 1 pt wide, sit beside their labels: a brick wall icon (top-left, beside 'Strong long-term performance'), a network icon of a central circle with four squares joined by lines (top-right, beside 'Grow existing strategies & launch new products'), a globe showing continents (right, beside 'More diversification'), a trophy cup with a star in light blue (#4A9FD8) (left, beside 'Enduring competitive advantages'), and two standing figures with a double-headed light blue arrow between them (bottom, above 'Greater market reach / information').

Footer in navy #002540, regular sans, all caps with wide letter-spacing, about 1.1% of slide height. Accent colours: navy #002F4A, dark green #237239, bright green #26A049, pale green #ADD2AD, light grey #D9D7D1, light blue #4A9FD8 on the icon details. Arcs are flat fills with no shadows, gradients or rounded corners. A short thin navy rule (about 0.2% of height) sits between the footer URL and the page number.

Chart 1, Flagship Infrastructure (BIF V): centre reads '80%' over 'Re-ups'. Single-slide content on a plain off-white field with a centred two-line title across the top at about 9% from the top edge. The footnote sits bottom-left at about 88% and the BROOKFIELD.COM wordmark with a short rule and the page number sits bottom-right at about 92%. Left margin about 5%, right margin about 5%. Year labels 2016 and 2026 are centred above their donuts.

**Visuals**

Two donut charts and one arrow. Chart 1 (left, labelled 2016): donut with centre text 320+ over Clients, about 1.9x strategies per client in a grey box below. Segments clockwise from 12 o'clock: Sovereign Wealth Fund blue about 4%, Public & Private Pension green about 50%, Insurance purple about 12%, Endowment / Foundation mauve about 16%, Other light green about 17% (all segment values are estimates, no values printed). Chart 2 (right, labelled 2026): donut with centre text 2,500+ over Clients, 2.6x strategies per client in a grey box below. Segments clockwise from 12 o'clock: Sovereign Wealth Fund blue about 3%, Public & Private Pension green about 28%, Insurance purple about 10%, Endowment / Foundation mauve about 23%, Other light green about 36% (estimates, no values printed). Both donuts have a hole about 50% of the outer diameter, no gaps between segments, no outlines. Legend (centre): five entries, each a filled square swatch followed by label: blue #1F5C8A Sovereign Wealth Fund; green #489B48 Public & Private Pension; purple #5F265F Insurance; mauve #BFA8BF Endowment / Foundation; light green #ADD2AD Other (Financial, Family Office, Unions, & Corporates). Arrow: a navy #002540 horizontal line about 0.4% thick with a solid triangular arrowhead pointing right, running from about x 38.5% to x 61.5% at about 42% height, placed above the legend and between the two donuts. No photographs, logos or icons. Highlighted points: none.

Background: Solid off-white #F2F1EF covering the entire slide. Flat off-white background #F2F1EF with no gradient, texture or imagery. 13

**Layout**

Single slide with a centred title across the top, a centred bold subtitle beneath it, and three donut charts in a horizontal row (2020 small, 2023 medium, 2026 large) separated by two navy chevrons pointing right. A centred legend sits below the charts, a footnote is flush left near the bottom, and a footer with BROOKFIELD.COM, a short rule and the page number 13 is at bottom right. Margins are roughly 5 percent on the left and right.

**Visuals**

Three donut charts, each with a navy North America segment, a green Europe segment, a light green APAC segment and a lilac Middle East segment, all drawn from 12 o'clock clockwise. Chart titles are the years 2020, 2023 and 2026 above each donut. No numeric values or axes are printed; segment shares are not labelled. Estimated shares read from the image: 2020 about 45 percent North America, about 10 percent Europe, about 30 percent APAC, about 12 percent Middle East; 2023 about 35 percent North America, about 10 percent Europe, about 35 percent APAC, about 20 percent Middle East; 2026 about 60 percent North America, about 12 percent Europe, about 20 percent APAC, about 8 percent Middle East. Centre labels: 2023 donut reads '+20%' over 'vs 2020'; 2026 donut reads '+43%' over 'vs 2023'. The 2020 donut has no centre label. Scale: the 2020 donut is about 13.8 percent wide, the 2023 donut about 16.9 percent, and the 2026 donut about 22.5 percent, so size encodes the year's capital base. Legend below the charts: navy-blue square 'North America', green square 'Europe', light green square 'APAC', lilac square 'Middle East'. Two navy chevrons (stroke #002540, about 0.9 percent of slide height thick, round-capped, no fill) sit between the donuts as a progression arrow. No photographs, logos or icons.

**Design**

Background: Solid off-white #F2F1EF covering the full slide. Warm off-white background #F2F1EF with no gradient or texture. Title in a light, high-contrast serif display face (SeasonMix-Regular or closest generic: transitional serif), regular weight, navy #002540, about 5.9 percent of slide height. Subtitle and year labels in a bold geometric sans-serif (SeasonSans-Bold or closest: grotesque sans), navy #002540 and #0F3557, about 3.3 to 3.6 percent of slide height. Donut centre labels in SeasonSans-Bold for the percentage (#002540, about 3.3 percent) and SeasonSans-Regular for 'vs' lines (#002540, about 2.2 percent). Legend and body labels in SeasonSans-Regular, #0F3557, about 2.6 percent of slide height. Footnote in SeasonSans-Regular, black #000000, about 1.5 percent. Footer brand text in SeasonSans-Regular, letter-spaced capitals, navy #002540, about 1.1 percent. Segment palette: navy #1D5A85, green #489B48, light green #ADD2AD, lilac #BFA8BF. Donut segments are flat fills with no outlines, shadows or gradients; the donut hole is the background colour. Chevrons are flat navy #002540 strokes.

14

**Layout**

A single centred title sits in the upper part of the slide, spanning two centred lines, with the donut chart centred horizontally below it and scattered outline icons around it. The footer sits bottom right: 'BROOKFIELD.COM', a short horizontal rule, and the page number '14' on one baseline, with a right margin of about 5% of the width. There is no left-aligned grid; all main content is centred on the vertical axis.

**Visuals**

One donut chart (ring with a hollow centre) divided into five equal-sized segments, drawn as flat fills with no gaps or outlines. Segments clockwise from the top: Infrastructure (dark blue #1D5A85, top-right, from 12 o'clock to about 2 o'clock), Energy (green #489B48, right), Private Equity (pale green #ADD2AD, bottom), Real Estate (dark purple #5F265F, lower-left), Credit (pale mauve #BFA8BF, upper-left). The hole in the centre is filled with the background colour #F2F1EF. Each segment carries a label and a small line icon: Infrastructure has a white transmission tower with signal arcs; Energy has a navy leaf outline; Private Equity has a navy briefcase outline; Real Estate has white outline icons of a house and a multi-window office building; Credit has a navy outline icon of a hand holding a coin. Scattered around the donut, on the background, are loose thin white/light outline icons, not connected to the chart: a delivery truck at about x 54.2-56.5%, y 30.8-34.2%; a cardboard box or sofa-like object at about x 57.2-59.4%, y 34.7-38.0%; a briefcase-like or safe-like icon at about x 36.7-38.7%, y 47.7-50.8%; an office building outline at about x 36.6-38.4%, y 54.4-57.8%; and a cluster of two buildings at about x 37.8-39.7%, y 60.7-64.0%. The outline icons are white at very low contrast against the pale background. No photographs. No chart axes, legend or values are printed.

**Design**

Background: Flat solid light warm grey #F2F1EF covering the entire slide.

**Layout**

A single centred title sits at the top of the slide, spanning nearly the full width with generous side margins. A large segmented circular wheel is centred horizontally and sits in the middle band of the slide below the title, with empty space above and below it. A small footer at the lower right holds the URL, a short dash rule and the page number in one line, with no logo.

**Visuals**

One segmented ring chart (a sunburst-style wheel) with two concentric rings around a small empty centre hole. The inner ring has five segments: Credit (light mauve #BFA8BF, with a hand-and-coin style icon), Infrastructure (blue #1D5A85, with a transmission tower icon), Energy (green #489B48, with a leaf icon), Private Equity (pale green #ADD2AD, with a briefcase icon) and Real Estate (purple #5F265F, with a house and office building icon). The outer ring is divided into the same five colour families: blue Infrastructure segments Utilities (pylon icon), Transport (truck icon), Midstream (storage/pipeline icon), Data (cell tower with signal icon); green Energy segments Hydro (water drop icon), Solar (sun/gear icon), Wind (wind turbine icon), Other Energy Solutions (solar panel icon); pale green Private Equity segments Infrastructure Services (gear icon), Industrials (battery icon), Business Services (briefcase icon), Technology Services (wifi signal icon); purple Real Estate segments Housing (house and building icon), Commercial (office building icon), Hospitality (hotel icon), Retail (shopping bag icon); mauve Credit segments Asset-Backed Finance (crane/aircraft icon with a vehicle), Real Asset Finance (house in circle icon), Opportunistic Credit (hand with dollar sign icon), Corporate Credit (briefcase icon). Segment labels run radially, with outer labels rotated to follow the wheel. Each segment is separated by a thin lighter line, and a thick white circular gap separates the inner ring from the outer ring. Icons are thin single-weight line drawings in dark navy or white matching the label colour. No axes, legend or data values.

**Design**

Background: Solid off-white #F2F1EF covering the whole slide. Off-white background (#F2F1EF) with no gradient or texture. Title in SeasonMix-Regular, a light-weight, regular-width grotesque-style serif-less display face, dark navy #002540, at about 5.9% of slide height. Segment labels are SeasonSans-Bold, a bold sans-serif, at about 1.3% of slide height; labels on dark segments are white #FFFFFF and labels on light segments are dark navy #0F3557. Footer is SeasonSans-Regular, sans-serif, uppercase, about 1.1% of slide height, navy #002540. Palette: navy #1D5A85 blue, green #489B48, pale green #ADD2AD, purple #5F265F, mauve #BFA8BF. Shapes are flat with no corner radii, shadows or gradients.

- Suggested repair: Enlarge or simplify the sunburst on slides 15 and 16 and the sub-sector labels, and fold the near-empty divider and icon-only pages into content slides that carry a claim.

**Layout**

Single full-width title line in the upper band, centred horizontally, with the title's baseline near 14% of slide height. Below it, one large centred radial donut diagram occupies the middle of the slide, spanning roughly x 30% to 70% and y 18% to 88%, with its centre at about x 50%, y 53%. The diagram has three concentric rings: a centre hole, a middle ring of 20 sector labels grouped by parent sector, and an outer ring of 40 sub-sector labels. **Visuals**

Radial sunburst diagram with three concentric rings and five parent sectors. Infrastructure is blue #1D5A85 in the top-right quadrant, running from about 12 o'clock to 3 o'clock. Energy is green #489B48 in the right and lower-right, from about 3 o'clock to 5 o'clock. Private Equity is pale green #ADD2AD along the bottom, from about 5 o'clock to 8 o'clock. Real Estate is plum #5F265F in the left and lower-left, from about 8 o'clock to 10 o'clock. Credit is mauve #BFA8BF in the upper-left, from about 10 o'clock to 12 o'clock. Thin off-white gaps (#F2F1EF, about 0.3% of slide width) separate the sectors and rings. Outline-style icons in dark navy #002540 sit in the middle ring: Infrastructure has a utility tower (Utilities), a truck (Transport), a warehouse or building (Midstream) and a transmission mast (Data). Energy has a water drop (Hydro), a sun or gear (Solar), a leaf (Wind area) and a wind turbine (Wind). Other Energy Solutions has a solar panel icon. Private Equity has a briefcase (Business Services), a wifi-like signal (Technology Services), a battery (Industrials) and a gear (Infrastructure Services). Real Estate has a house (Housing), a building (Commercial), a hotel building (Hospitality) and a shopping bag (Retail). Credit has a briefcase (Corporate Credit), a hand with coins (Opportunistic Credit), a house in a circle (Real Asset Finance) and a cart with containers (Asset-Backed Finance). The centre is a small off-white circle (#F2F1EF) at about x 48%, y 50%, about 4% wide, with the label Credit area at top-left above it. No photographs or charts are present.

### Slide 17

**Text**

Our platforms grow at different points in time, but create
consistent growth on a consolidated basis
Across the
Cycle
Infrastructure
Energy
Real Estate
Pro-Cyclical
Counter Cyclical

17

**Layout**

Two-line centred headline sits across the top of the slide, with the wave diagram filling the centre and right. The left column holds the green 'Across the Cycle' label block at about 7.7% from the left edge, and the 'Pro-Cyclical' and 'Counter Cyclical' labels sit above and below the waves at about 25% from the left. The footer runs along the bottom right, with BROOKFIELD.COM, a short rule and the page number 17 at about 93% of the height.

**Visuals**

Illustration: a diagram of two sinusoidal waves and one rising arrow on a navy field. Shapes and labels: (1) a grey dashed sine wave labelled 'Pro-Cyclical', about three half-cycles, peaking near x 33% and x 71%, with troughs near x 46% and x 63%; (2) a blue dashed sine wave labelled 'Counter Cyclical', out of phase with the grey wave, troughs near x 32% and x 71%, peaks near x 53% and x 79%; (3) a thick solid green arrow running from lower left (about x 18%, y 64%) to upper right (about x 89%, y 36%) with a filled triangular arrowhead at the upper right, drawn over both waves. The two waves cross each other at about x 42% and x 61% and the arrow crosses them at the same points. No axes, legend or values. Dashes are roughly even, with rounded ends. Full-width, no box, no shadow, no overlay.

**Design**

Background: Solid navy #002540 covering the full slide. Flat navy background #002540 with no gradient, texture or imagery. Headline in SeasonMix Regular, sans-serif, white #FFFFFF, about 5.9% of slide height per line, centred. 'Across the Cycle' in SeasonMix Bold, green #489B48, about 3.7%. Sub-labels 'Infrastructure / Energy / Real Estate' in SeasonSans Regular, green #489B48, about 2.6%. 'Pro-Cyclical' in SeasonMix Bold, light grey #B8BEC6. 'Counter Cyclical' in SeasonMix Bold, blue #419AD9. Arrow fill bright green #6DBE45, no outline. Grey wave dashed #A9B1BA, about 0.3% stroke. Blue wave dashed #3A7FC1, about 0.3% stroke. Footer in SeasonSans Regular, white, about 1.1% of height, letter-spaced capitals. No corner radii or shadows.

### Slide 18

**Review notes**

- Review: Weaknesses are consequential: many pages are near-empty dividers or three-icon placeholders (slides 8, 9, 18, 30, 31, 36, 45, 50, 55, 61), the sunburst on slides 14 to 16 shrinks to unreadable text, and footnotes and the page footer are tiny.

**Text**

Consistency of performance / BROOKFIELD.COM / 18

**Layout**

Single centred composition: a trophy icon sits above a large centred title on the vertical middle of the slide, with a footer line at bottom right. The title is centred horizontally; the footer is right-aligned at the bottom margin with a short horizontal rule between the site name and the page number. Nothing is in the top area or the left and right margins apart from the title width.

**Visuals**

One icon: a white outline trophy cup (line-art, roughly 6.1% of slide width by 9.6% of slide height) with a shield-shaped cup body, two side handles curving outward and downward, a short stem and a flat rectangular base. Inside the cup body is a five-pointed star outline drawn in a medium blue (about #4A90D9) with a stroke of roughly the same weight as the white outline. Stroke weight is thin and uniform. No photograph, chart or diagram. Footer includes a short horizontal white rule (about 2.5% of slide width) between the site name and the page number.

**Design**

Background: Solid navy #002540 covering the full slide. Solid dark navy background #002540 with no gradient, texture or image. Title text is off-white/white #FFFFFF in a high-contrast serif display face resembling SeasonMix Regular (a modern serif with sharp, slightly flared terminals), regular weight, sentence case, title size about 8.9% of slide height, lowercase body with capital C only. 22

**Layout**

Eight-cell grid of icon-and-label pairs in two rows of four columns, separated by thin light-grey vertical and horizontal rules, with a full-width-centred title at the top and a small footer at lower right. Title is centred horizontally near the top margin; cell labels are centred under each icon; footer URL and page number sit right-aligned at the bottom margin with a short dash between them.

**Visuals**

Eight minimal line icons, one per grid cell, drawn in navy #002540 with light-blue #3B9BDB accents. Row 1: (1) a shield outline containing a globe with a blue globe grid, for Flagships; (2) two open hands holding a blue dollar sign above them, for Insurance capital; (3) a bank building with columns and a base line, with a blue magnifying glass at upper right, for Equity strategies; (4) three overlapping circles, outlined in navy, for Credit strategies. Row 2: (5) concentric target-like arcs with a blue cursor arrow pointing into them, for Sector focused; (6) a navy globe outline with a blue cursor arrow at its left, for Geographic focused; (7) three person figures, the centre one navy and the two side ones outlined in blue, for Partner managers; (8) a navy person outline in a circle with a blue check-mark circle overlapping lower right, for Public affiliates. Vertical rules at about x 27.3%, 50.0% and 72.7% span y 30.1% to 82.6%; horizontal rule at about y 56.3% spans x 4.7% to 95.3%; rules are light grey #D0D0CE, about 0.1% of slide width.

**Design**

Background: Flat off-white #F2F1EF.

23

**Layout**

A centred single-line-group headline sits across the top third of the slide, with three equal-width boxed cards in one row below it, spanning the full content width with about 2% side margins. Each card has a logo at its top-left and a two-column Originated by / Deployed in row with a chevron between them near the lower half. The footer 'BROOKFIELD.COM — 23' sits at bottom right, right-aligned, with the page number at the far right.

**Visuals**

Three company logos and three double-chevron arrow icons. Logo 1: Kobalt, a red-orange (#FF3B26 approx.) geometric K mark followed by black lowercase wordmark 'Kobalt'. Logo 2: Origis Energy, four stacked curved arc strokes in orange, dark blue, blue and green on the left, followed by orange wordmark 'Origis Energy' with registered mark. Logo 3: Compass Datacenters, a circular mark split dark slate grey (#37424A approx.) on the left half and orange (#F7820A approx.) on the right half with a small green leaf accent, followed by dark slate grey 'COMPASS' capitals and orange italic 'datacenters' with registered mark. Each card has a thin outline chevron pair (two open right-pointing chevrons, dark navy #002540 stroke, about 0.2% stroke) between 'Originated by' and 'Deployed in'. No photographs or charts.

**Design**

Background: Solid flat colour #F2F1EF covering the whole slide. Flat off-white background #F2F1EF with no gradient or texture. Headline in dark navy #002540, light-weight sans-serif (SeasonMix Regular, close to a grotesque sans-serif), normal weight, centred, large (about 5.9% of slide height per line). Labels 'Originated by' and 'Deployed in' in bold sans-serif (SeasonSans Bold, close to a grotesque sans) in accent blue #419AD9, letter-spaced, about 3% of slide height. Values 'Credit', 'Energy', 'Private Equity', 'Infrastructure' in regular sans-serif (SeasonSans Regular) in navy #002540, about 3% of slide height. Cards have square corners, 1px light grey (#CFCDCA approx.) outline, no fill separate from background, no shadow. Footer small caps sans-serif about 1.1% of slide height in navy.

### Slide 24

**Review notes**

- Worth studying: Uses a clean table with target and actual gross and net returns side by side for each strategy, making comparison easy.
- Review: Individual pages are clean and legible, with strong hierarchy on slides 4, 24 and 46, consistent navy and green identity, and a sensible sentence-style title chain.
- Worth keeping: Keep the slide 4 headline-number layout, the slide 24 table with bolded actuals, the slide 46 stacked bars with a record callout, and the CFO bridge from capital to earnings to dividend on slides 62 to 68.

**Text**

**Layout**

Single-slide table layout on a light warm-grey field with a centred two-line title across the top, followed by a full-width data table with a two-tier header (group labels Gross Return and Net Return above column labels) and five data rows. Left margin about 5.4% of width for row labels; table rules span about 4.7% to 95.3% of width. A small endnote line sits bottom-left at about 88% height and a footer with BROOKFIELD.COM, a short dash and the slide number 24 sits bottom-right at about 92% height.

**Design**

Background warm off-white #F2F1EF. Title and table text navy #002540. Body and table text in SeasonSans Regular, sans-serif geometric grotesque, weight regular; headers and Actual values in SeasonSans Bold. ### Slide 27

**Text**

Our recipe for new strategies is built on discipline at every step / Leveraging our capabilities… / Play to our strengths / Focus on adjacencies / Chase durability and longevity / Target leadership positions / …While being prudent / Walk before running / Keep mistakes small, learn fast / Scale decisively / Tap into the Brookfield ecosystem / BROOKFIELD.COM / 27

**Layout**

Two equal columns sit below a single full-width title, separated by a thin vertical divider at the slide centre. Each column has a navy header bar at the top and four icon-and-text rows beneath it, with the icon at the left and the text starting just right of it. The title is centred horizontally near the top, with a left margin of about 5% and a right margin of about 5%. The footer, a 'BROOKFIELD.COM' URL, a short dash and the slide number 27, is right-aligned in the bottom right corner.

**Visuals**

Eight line icons, each drawn in thin dark-navy outline with a small blue accent. Left column, top to bottom: (1) a pickaxe-like tool, a navy diagonal handle with a blue curved arc at its head and a small navy tick at the top right; (2) two overlapping outline circles, a Venn-style pair; (3) an outline shield with no inner detail; (4) an outline trophy cup with a blue five-point star on the bowl and a navy base. Right column, top to bottom: (5) a navy check mark with a blue upper stroke; (6) an outline magnifying glass with a blue dollar sign inside the lens; (7) an outline set square (right-angle triangle) with tick marks along its edges and a blue inner triangle; (8) an outline globe with navy continent shapes. No photographs, charts or diagrams. Icons are not boxed, filled or shadowed.

**Design**

Background: Solid light warm grey #F2F1EF. Flat, minimal, corporate. Light warm-grey background #F2F1EF with no gradient or texture. Title in a light-weight geometric grotesque serif-free display sans (SeasonMix Regular, close to a neo-grotesque) in navy #002540, large, about 5.9% of slide height. Column headers in bold sans (SeasonSans Bold) in white #FFFFFF on navy #14486E bars, about 3.7% of slide height. Bullet-style body rows in regular sans (SeasonSans Regular) navy #002540, about 4.4% of slide height. Footer in small uppercase regular sans, navy #002540, about 1.1%. Header bars are flat rectangles with square corners and no shadow. Divider is a thin navy vertical line about 0.3% of slide width. Icons use thin navy outline strokes with blue #3A8FD6 accents.

**Layout**

Single-slide content layout on a full-bleed off-white field. The title runs across the top at about 9% from the top, left-aligned at about 6% from the left margin and spanning to about 94%. Below it a row of three equal navy panels spans the width from about 4.8% to 95.2%, with a blue BSIP pill tab overlapping the top-left corner of the row. The lower area is split into a left text column (about 4.7% to 25%), a chevron bracket at about 29%, and a bar chart on the right (about 35% to 94%) with its baseline at about 86% from the top. A small footer line with the brand URL, a short rule and the slide number sits bottom right at about 92% from the top.

**Visuals**

Icons and chart. (1) Line-chart icon in the first navy panel: a white L-shaped axis (vertical then horizontal, bottom-left corner) with a blue #419AD9 zigzag trend line rising to the upper right with an arrowhead at the end. (2) Layers icon in the second panel: a white circle outline containing three stacked blue #419AD9 chevron-diamond layers. (3) Overlapping circles icon in the third panel: a white circle outline overlapping a blue #419AD9 circle outline, the blue one lower-right. (4) Bar chart titled Fundraising ($B), vertical bars, no visible y-axis or gridlines, baseline in navy #002540. Series values printed above each bar: 2024 $1.0 (bar about 41% to 48% across, shorter bar), 2025 $2.6 (about 61% to 67%, medium bar), 2026 $3.3 (about 81% to 87%, tallest bar). Bar heights are proportional to the printed values, so the 2025 bar is about 79% of the 2026 height and the 2024 bar about 30%. Bars are solid #1D5A85 with no outlines. No legend. No highlighted points. (5) Navy chevron bracket: a thick #002540 stroke in the shape of a right-pointing angle bracket spanning about 29% to 33% horizontally and 52% to 88% vertically, pointing right toward the chart.

**Design**

Background: Solid off-white #F2F1EF. Off-white background #F2F1EF with flat, unshadowed shapes and no gradients. Title in SeasonMix-Regular, a light-weight display face with flared, serif-like character, navy #002540, about 5.9% of slide height. Panel text is SeasonSans-Regular, white #FFFFFF, about 3.0% of slide height. Lead-in and emphasised numbers are SeasonSans-Bold: 'Built patiently over 8 years' navy #002540 at about 3.0%; '$26B' and '~$3B+' in blue #1D5A85, numerals about 8.2% and currency and unit letters about 5.9%; 'Fundraising' bold navy at about 3.0%. Chart value labels and year labels are SeasonSans-Regular navy #002540 at about 3.0%. Accents are #419AD9 (BSIP tab and icons) and #1D5A85 (bars and figures). Navy panels #002540 are square-cornered with thin white vertical divider lines between them. The BSIP tab is a pill with full rounded ends. Footer is SeasonSans-Regular capitals with wide letter-spacing at about 1.1%, navy.

**Layout**

Full-width title is centred on the top band, sitting above a three-panel navy strip that spans the upper half of the slide. Below, a left column holds the caption and three large statistics. A navy chevron separates that column from a grey box on the right that holds three list items with icons. Margins are about 5% on the left and 5% on the right. The footer 'BROOKFIELD.COM' and the page number 29 sit bottom-right on one baseline.

**Visuals**

Six line icons and one chevron. (1) Top-left panel: two overlapping outline circles, the left one white and the right one light blue #419AD9, stroke about 2 px. (2) Top-middle panel: a white outline circle containing three stacked blue #419AD9 chevron layers (a layers icon). (3) Top-right panel: a line chart icon, an L-shaped white axis with a blue zigzag line rising to an arrowhead at upper right. (4) Lower-right grey box: outline overlapping circles in navy #002540. (5) Trophy outline in navy with a blue star on the cup. (6) Blue check mark over a navy check mark. (7) A thick navy #002540 chevron pointing right, apex at about x 54.9%, y 69%, stroke about 4 px, spanning y 51.7% to 87.8%. No photographs. No chart.

**Design**

Background: Solid off-white #F2F1EF. Off-white background #F2F1EF with a flat, unshadowed look. Title in SeasonMix-Regular (a serif-like display face, regular weight) in navy #002540, about 5.9% of slide height. Body text in SeasonSans-Regular, navy #002540 on the light areas and white #FFFFFF on the navy panels, about 3.0% of slide height. Statistics and the caption subhead in SeasonSans-Bold, #1D5A85 for the numbers and #002540 for the caption, numbers about 8.2% of slide height. Accents: light blue #419AD9 for the BII pill and the icon highlights. Shapes are square-cornered rectangles except the BII pill, which is fully rounded (pill). Thin white 0.3% vertical rules divide the navy panels, and faint white rules extend below the panels. No gradients or shadows.

It starts with a dark blue circle labelled <1% at the 2026 end, and ends with a dark blue circle labelled 15%+ at the top right end, above and to the right of the curve. The horizontal baseline is a thin dark navy (#002540) line with the label 2026 under its left end and Long Term under its right end. A large light grey (#D9D7D1) circle sits over the middle of the chart, centred on $14T with the caption Total addressable market beneath it. No legend. Logo: AllianceBernstein square logo, black square (#000000) with white stylised [A/B] brackets and a white horizontal bar, placed in the left panel. The logo is boxed square with no rounding. Key takeaways
1
Increasingly diversified
2
Consistency of performance
3
Positioned for the future
BROOKFIELD.COM
37

Centred single-column composition: the title sits centred at the top, and three numbered takeaway rows are stacked vertically in the middle of the slide, each number box left of its bold statement. Three outlined square number boxes, each with a thin navy stroke, containing the numerals 1, 2 and 3 in a light-weight thin blue sans-serif numeral (about #3A9AD9). ### Slide 45

**Review notes**

- Review: Weaknesses are consequential: many pages are near-empty dividers or three-icon placeholders (slides 8, 9, 18, 30, 31, 36, 45, 50, 55, 61), the sunburst on slides 14 to 16 shrinks to unreadable text, and footnotes and the page footer are tiny.

**Text**

Our success is consistent / BROOKFIELD.COM / 45

**Layout**

Single centred statement on a plain full-bleed navy field; the headline sits in the vertical middle of the slide and is centred horizontally. Footer strip sits bottom-right with the domain, a short rule and the slide number on one baseline, with a right margin of about 5.7% of the width.

**Visuals**

none

**Design**

Background: Solid navy #002540 covering the full slide. Solid deep navy background #002540 with no gradient, texture or imagery. Headline in SeasonMix Regular (a serif-leaning display face, roman weight, normal case) in white #FFFFFF at about 8.9% of slide height, comfortably the dominant element. Footer in SeasonSans Regular (sans-serif, regular weight, all caps for the domain) in white #FFFFFF at about 1.1% of slide height with generous letter-spacing. A thin white horizontal rule (about 1px stroke) separates the domain from the page number. No shapes, shadows, corner radii or gradients.

### Slide 46

**Review notes**

- Worth studying: A stacked bar chart of fundraising by year with organic and inorganic splits and a record-year label that draws the eye to the latest bar.
- Review: Individual pages are clean and legible, with strong hierarchy on slides 4, 24 and 46, consistent navy and green identity, and a sensible sentence-style title chain.
- Worth keeping: Keep the slide 4 headline-number layout, the slide 24 table with bolded actuals, the slide 46 stacked bars with a record callout, and the CFO bridge from capital to earnings to dividend on slides 62 to 68.

**Text**

Fundraising is consistently growing through economic cycles / $163B raised over the last 12 months / Record Year / $136 / $112 / $93 / $83 / $71 / $41 / 2020 / 2021 / 2022 / 2023 / 2024 / 2025 / 2026E / Organic / Inorganic / Fundraising figures represent full calendar year / See Notice to Recipients and Endnotes, including endnote 10 / BROOKFIELD.COM / 46

**Layout**

Single-column, centred layout on a full-bleed off-white field. The title and subtitle are centred across the top, with the title at about 9% from the top and the subtitle directly beneath it. A full-width column bar chart fills the middle, with its baseline at about 72% of the height and year labels below it. The legend is centred under the chart at about 83%. The footnote sits bottom-left at about 89%, and the footer (BROOKFIELD.COM, a short rule, and the page number 46) sits bottom-right at about 92%. Margins are roughly 6% on the left and right.

**Visuals**

Chart: vertical stacked column chart, seven columns, one per year. Columns are 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026E, read left to right. Title: none inside the chart; the slide headline and subtitle serve as its title. Axes: no visible y-axis or tick labels; the x-axis is labelled with the years. A y-axis scale of 20 to 160 exists only as near-invisible text in #F2F1EF (see elements). Series: Organic (dark green #489B48, bottom segment) and Inorganic (light green #ADD2AD, top segment). Printed values are totals only: 2020 $41; 2021 $71; 2022 $93; 2023 $83; 2024 $136; 2025 $112; 2026E no value printed but its column is the tallest and is labelled Record Year. Organic and inorganic split values are not printed. The 2020, 2021, 2023 and 2025 columns show only the organic segment. The 2022 column has an inorganic segment about 30% of its height. The 2024 column has an inorganic segment about 40% of its height. The 2026E column has an inorganic segment about 25% of its height; these are visual estimates. Legend: centred below the x-axis; dark green square followed by Organic, then light green square followed by Inorganic. Highlighted point: the 2026E column carries the bold label Record Year directly above it, right-aligned to the column. Baseline: a single dark navy #002540 horizontal line under all columns, about 0.2% of the height thick. Columns: flat rectangles with square corners and no shadows, no outlines, evenly spaced with gaps about equal to their width; each column is centred over its year label.

**Design**

Background: Solid off-white #F2F1EF covering the entire slide. Flat, minimal corporate style. Background is warm off-white #F2F1EF with no gradient or texture. Headline text is navy #002540 in a light-weight geometric grotesque sans (Season Mix Regular), about 5.9% of slide height for the title. Subtitle is bold sans (Season Sans Bold) in steel blue #1D5A85, about 4.6% of slide height. Chart value labels and year labels are Season Sans Regular in navy #002540, about 3.2% of slide height for values and 3.3% for years. Record Year is Season Sans Bold navy #002540, about 3.2%. Legend labels are Season Sans Regular navy, about 3.3%. Footnote is Season Sans Regular in black #000000, about 1.5%. Footer is Season Sans Regular in navy, about 1.1%, letter-spaced capitals for BROOKFIELD.COM. Accent colours: greens #489B48 and #ADD2AD. Shapes: square-cornered rectangles, no rounded corners, no shadows.

### Slide 47

**Review notes**

- Review: Some charts have an uneven axis or crowded labelling (slide 47 has two scales sharing one chart, slide 26 has very small labels), which leaves a competent but not exceptional deck.
- What would change the score: I would cut the repeated dividers and the 'Increasingly diversified' echo on slides 8 and 9, and raise the footnote and chart label sizes so small text on slides 26, 47 and 60 is readable.

47

**Layout**

A single centred title sits near the top, spanning about 28% to 72% of the width at roughly 9% from the top. The chart fills the slide width from about 10% to 92%, with seven evenly spaced columns (2020 to 2026) sitting on a thin horizontal baseline at about 80% of the height. The footnote is left-aligned at the bottom left (about 5% from the left), the legend is centred under the chart, and the footer with brand URL and slide number is right-aligned at the bottom right (about 4% from the right and 7% from the bottom). Margins are generous and there is no visible y-axis.

**Visuals**

Chart: combined column and line chart with no printed title. Columns are FBC, drawn as solid bars in #1D5A85 with values printed above each bar: 2020 $277, 2021 $325, 2022 $392, 2023 $440, 2024 $514, 2025 $563, 2026 $672 (in $B). Line series is FRE, a thick rounded blue line about 0.9% of slide height wide in #4A9BDB, with values printed above each point: 2020 $1.3, 2021 $1.6, 2022 $2.0, 2023 $2.2, 2024 $2.3, 2025 $2.7, 2026 $3.2 (in $B). Y-axis tick labels are present in the file but are coloured #F2F1EF, identical to the background, so they are invisible: the FBC scale runs 130, 230, 330, 430, 530, 630, 730 and the FRE scale runs 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3. Both scales are therefore not visible and no gridlines are shown. X-axis is a thin black-navy horizontal line at the column baseline with year labels 2020 to 2026 beneath each column. Annotation: a light grey (#D9D7D1) straight diagonal arrow, about 0.5% of slide height thick, runs from about (18%, 46%) up to an arrowhead at about (79%, 15%), passing behind the callout circle. Callout: a filled light grey (#D9D7D1) circle centred at about (50%, 29%), about 9.4% of slide width in diameter, containing '16%' in bold navy above 'CAGR' in regular navy. Highlighted points: none beyond the printed values. Legend: centred under the chart, FBC shown as a small filled #1D5A85 rectangle and FRE as a short thick #4A9BDB line with round caps.

**Design**

Background: Solid off-white #F2F1EF covering the entire slide. Warm off-white flat background with no texture, gradient or shadows. Title in SeasonMix-Regular, a display serif-like face, regular weight, navy #002540, about 5.9% of slide height. Chart value labels and year labels in SeasonSans-Regular (a sans-serif), regular weight, navy #002540 for FRE values and years, black #000000 for FBC values. Callout '16%' in SeasonSans-Bold, navy #002540, about 4.6% of slide height; 'CAGR' in SeasonSans-Regular about 3.7%. Body and data labels about 3.2% of slide height. Footnote about 1.5% of slide height, black. Footer brand text in SeasonSans-Regular, about 1.1%, letter-spaced capitals, navy. Accents: bar blue #1D5A85, line blue #4A9BDB, grey #D9D7D1. Shapes have square corners on bars and no outlines.

### Slide 54

**Text**

Wealth Solutions provides a unique growth engine / We have a differentiated insurance partnership / 56% / 6% / 38% / $150B / 2026 FBC / Growing to / Private Funds / Private Non-Fund (SMAs) / Liquid Credit / 50% / 18% / 32% / $360B / 2031 FBC / Figures presented represent fee-bearing capital we manage on behalf of Brookfield Wealth Solutions, which is incorporated across all five of our business groups / See Notice to Recipients and Endnotes, including endnotes 2 and 10 / BROOKFIELD.COM / 54

**Layout**

Two donut charts sit side by side in a symmetrical three-column arrangement, with a centre column holding the 'Growing to' label, a right-pointing arrow and a three-item legend between them. The title is centred at the top, with a centred bold subtitle beneath it. A small left-aligned footnote sits near the bottom left, and a small footer with BROOKFIELD.COM, a short rule and the slide number sits at the bottom right. Margins are roughly 4.7% on the left and about 5% on the right.

**Visuals**

Two donut charts, each showing fee-bearing capital split into three segments. Left donut, titled 2026 FBC, total $150B, with segments: Private Funds 6% (dark blue #1D5A85, upper right, label 6% in white), Private Non-Fund (SMAs) 38% (green #489B48, bottom, label 38% in white), Liquid Credit 56% (pale green #ADD2AD, left and top, label 56% in dark navy). Right donut, titled 2031 FBC, total $360B, with segments: Private Funds 18% (dark blue #1D5A85, right side, label 18% in white), Private Non-Fund (SMAs) 32% (green #489B48, bottom, label 32% in white), Liquid Credit 50% (pale green #ADD2AD, left and top, label 50% in dark navy). Both donuts are of equal size, with a white-free inner hole filled with the background colour and a ring thickness about 30% of the outer radius. Between them, a solid dark navy #002540 arrow about 0.5% of slide height thick runs horizontally left to right, pointing at the right donut, with the label Growing to above it. The legend below the arrow has three square swatches: #1D5A85 for Private Funds, #489B48 for Private Non-Fund (SMAs), and #ADD2AD for Liquid Credit. No axes, no gridlines, no logos or photographs.

**Design**

Background: Solid off-white #F2F1EF covering the entire slide. Flat off-white background #F2F1EF with no gradients, shadows or textures. Title in SeasonMix Regular serif-like display face, navy #002540, large. Subtitle and body text in SeasonSans, bold for the subtitle and numbers, regular for the legend and year labels. Accent colours: dark blue #1D5A85, mid green #489B48, pale green #ADD2AD, subtitle blue #14486E. Title cap height is about 6% of slide height; subtitle about 3.7%; large donut totals about 6.7%; segment labels and legend about 2.6%; footnote about 1.5%; footer about 1.1%. Shapes are flat with no outlines and no rounded corners.

### Slide 56

**Text**

Additional drivers / Emerging themes are poised to play a bigger role over the next five years than the prior five / Emerging themes / Private / wealth / Capital / markets / Carried / Interest / Balance sheet / investments / BROOKFIELD.COM / 56

**Layout**

Single centred column with the title at top centre, a bold subtitle line beneath it, and a four-column grid of equal cells below a grey header band spanning the content width. The footer sits bottom right with the URL, a short rule and the slide number on one baseline, with a right margin of about 5 percent.

**Visuals**

Four line icons in a row, each centred in its column above its label. Column 1: a thin outlined rectangle (blue #4A9FD8 stroke) containing a dark navy #0B2D4A head-and-shoulders figure silhouette with a blue upward arrow with a check-like tick at top right. ### Slide 59

**Text**

Carry is more than just our second leg of growth, / its already here / Cumulative realized carried interest / (funds raised post spin-off) / Years 6-10 / Next 5 Years / 2022 – 2025 / $0B / $9B / Target / $35B+ / Target / Costs / Net to BAM / Royalty to BN / See Notice to Recipients and Endnotes, including endnotes 8 and 10 / BROOKFIELD.COM / 59

**Layout**

Single unboxed slide with a centred two-line title at the top and a centred chart heading beneath it. Three donut-style figures sit left to right on a shared baseline: the 2022 to 2025 value with no ring, the Next 5 Years donut in the centre, and the larger Years 6-10 donut on the right. A centred three-item legend sits below the donuts, the source footnote is flush left at the bottom-left margin, and a small footer with the URL, a dash and the page number sits bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Two donut charts and one value callout. Chart type: donut rings (hole in the centre) with three segments each. Chart title: Cumulative realized carried interest, subtitle (funds raised post spin-off). Axes: none. Series, Next 5 Years donut: Costs (medium blue #419AD9) occupies the top-right arc from 12 o'clock to about 4 o'clock; Net to BAM (light blue #B3D7F0) occupies the bottom arc; Royalty to BN (dark blue #1D5A85) occupies the left arc from about 9 o'clock to 12 o'clock. Centre label: $9B and Target. Years 6-10 donut: same segment colours and similar proportions (Costs top-right, Net to BAM bottom, Royalty to BN left), drawn about 1.5 times larger. Centre label: $35B+ and Target. Labelled values: 2022 to 2025 shows $0B with no ring; Next 5 Years shows $9B; Years 6-10 shows $35B+. Segment values are not printed; the proportions are about one third each (about 33 percent) as drawn. Legend: Costs with medium blue square, Net to BAM with light blue square, Royalty to BN with dark blue square, in a horizontal row. Highlighted points: none.

**Design**

Background: Solid flat colour #F2F1EF (light warm grey) covering the whole slide. Plain light warm-grey background #F2F1EF with no gradient, texture or ornament. Title in a light serif display face (SeasonMix Regular style), colour navy #002540, centred, about 5.9 percent of slide height, two lines. **Layout**

Single-slide composition on a full-bleed off-white field: the two-line centred title sits across the top (about 9% to 21% of height), with the left chart area and a vertical divider at about 74% of width separating a right-hand text column. Left margin is about 5%, right margin about 5%; the source line sits bottom-left at about 88% height and the brand line with page number sits bottom-right at about 92% height.

**Visuals**

Chart: a J-curve line chart titled 'Investments Follow a J-Curve', drawn with a navy vertical y-axis arrow and a navy horizontal x-axis arrow meeting at the origin near (30%, 81%). The y-axis is labelled 'Distributable Earnings Contribution' with no numeric scale or values printed; the x-axis is labelled 'Time' with no numeric scale. Three light grey vertical divider lines (about 1 pt, #D0D0D0-ish) split the plot into three zones labelled 'Minimal DE contribution', 'Earnings build as strategies scale', and 'Meaningful DE growth driver'. One series: a single thick green curve (about 4 pt, #4E9A44) starting at the origin, dipping slightly below the x-axis near the first zone, rising gently and then steeply to an arrowhead at the upper right near (78%, 54%), where it points into the green target circle. No legend; no data points are marked other than the curve end arrowhead. Highlighted element: the green circle labelled 'Target 20%+ Return on Equity'. Also a solid navy filled circle at left with '$4B Invested to date' (a stat callout, not a chart series). Right-hand: a thin light grey horizontal rule under the 'Strategic uses of our balance sheet' heading, and a thin light grey vertical divider at about 74% of width running from about 14% to 83% of height.

**Design**

Background warm off-white #F2F1EF, flat, no gradient or texture. Chart heading and subheads in bold geometric sans (SeasonSans Bold, close to a grotesque sans), dark navy #082E4B, about 3.3% of slide height. Body and labels in regular weight sans (SeasonSans Regular), navy #002540 or #082E4B, about 3.0% to 3.7% of slide height; footnote about 1.5%; brand line about 1.1%. Accents: navy #002540 for the $4B circle and axes, pale green #ADD2AD for the target circle, mid green #4E9A44 for the J-curve. Shapes are flat with no shadows, no rounded corners beyond true circles, no gradients.

### Slide 62

**Review notes**

- Review: The deck has a clear route: agenda, section dividers, a three-part framing (diversified, consistent, positioned for the future) that is restated in takeaways on slides 37 and 71, and a CFO section that builds from fee-bearing capital to fee-related earnings to distributable earnings in slides 62 to 67.

### Slide 71

**Review notes**

- Review: The deck has a clear route: agenda, section dividers, a three-part framing (diversified, consistent, positioned for the future) that is restated in takeaways on slides 37 and 71, and a CFO section that builds from fee-bearing capital to fee-related earnings to distributable earnings in slides 62 to 67.

**Text**

Key takeaways
1
Purpose built model
Gives all different types of investors multiple options to invest with us
2
Resilient, diversified, and consistent
Across cash flows, fundraising, and earnings growth
3
Additional growth engines
Will drive the business over the next 5 years and beyond
5-year targets
$1.3T FBC
14% CAGR
$6.6B FRE
16% CAGR
$6.4B DE
18% CAGR
See Notice to Recipients and Endnotes, including endnote 10
BROOKFIELD.COM
71

**Layout**

Single slide with a centred title across the top at about 8.6% from the top. Three numbered takeaway rows sit in a left column starting at about 4.7% from the left, each row a square numeral box beside a bold heading and a regular sub-line, left-aligned at about 12.6%. A bordered panel on the right (about 64% to 90.2% across, 20.4% to 83.1% down) holds the 5-year targets stacked and centred. A footnote sits bottom left at about 87.8% down and a BROOKFIELD.COM footer with page number 71 sits bottom right at about 92.4% down, with margins of about 4.7% left and 5% right.

**Visuals**

Three outlined square icons, each about 5.4% wide and 9.5% tall, with a thin navy #002540 stroke of about 2 px and square corners, containing light blue #419AD9 thin sans-serif numerals 1, 2 and 3 centred inside. Beside them, a thin light grey #C8C8C8 hairline rectangle with square corners frames the 5-year targets column with no fill. Apart from these, there are no photographs, charts or images.

**Design**

Background: Solid off-white #F2F1EF. Flat off-white background with no gradient, shadow or texture. Titles and headings are navy #002540; body text is navy #002540; the target figures and numerals are light blue accent #419AD9; the footnote is black #000000. The title uses a high-contrast serif display face resembling SeasonMix Regular at about 5.9% of slide height. Headings are a bold geometric grotesque resembling SeasonSans Bold at about 4.4% of slide height. Sub-lines and CAGR labels are a regular weight of the same sans at about 3.3% to 4.4%. Footnote and footer are about 1.1% to 1.5% of slide height. Shapes have square corners and no shadows.

**Layout**

Single-column chart slide with a centred two-line title at the top spanning most of the width, a full-width dark navy band below the title, and a staircase chart beneath it. Three column headings sit above the chart at roughly 18%, 43% and 71% of width; the rising pill labels step diagonally from bottom-left to top-right. Vertical y-axis (RETURN) runs along the left at about 5% of width and the horizontal x-axis (RISK) along the bottom; a row of six category legend pills sits centred below the axis, and a small footer with the URL, dash and page number sits bottom-right, right-aligned to the margin at about 94% of width.

**Visuals**

Chart: illustrative staircase of credit strategies plotted as a risk/return profile, with no numeric scale or tick values. Vertical axis titled RETURN (arrow pointing up, increasing return); horizontal axis titled RISK (arrow pointing right, increasing risk). Three zone headings: Investment Grade (lower-left), Below Investment Grade (centre), Opportunistic & Hybrid (upper-right). Twenty-two grey pill-shaped bars, each carrying one strategy label, step upward and rightward in a diagonal from Liquid IG Corporate (bottom-left) to Opportunistic Credit (top-right); each label is coloured by its category: blue #419AD9 for real estate labels, dark blue #1D5A85 for infrastructure, pink #FF6699 for opportunistic, plum #5F265F for corporate performing credit, lilac #AE90AE for liquid, green #489B48 for asset-backed finance. Bars from bottom-left to top-right: Liquid IG Corporate; Global Infrastructure Debt - Opco; US Senior Real Estate Debt; Convertibles; High Yield Bonds; NAV Finance – Credit; Structured Investment Grade; Global Infrastructure Debt - Holdco; Bank Loans; Direct Lending; Global Real Estate Mezzanine Debt; Residential Non-Qualified Mortgages; US Subordinated Real Estate; Consumer NPL / RPL; Homebuilder Solutions; NAV Finance – GP Solutions; Diversified ABF; Venture Debt; Aviation Finance; Music Royalties; Opportunistic Credit. Legend: six pill-shaped tags in a row, Real estate (blue text), Infrastructure (dark blue text), Opportunistic (pink text), Corporate Performing Credit (plum text), Liquid (lilac text), Asset-Backed Finance (green text), all with light grey fill and no visible category colour swatches. No photographs, logos or icons.

**Design**

Background: Solid warm off-white #F2F1EF filling the entire slide. Warm off-white background with a single dark navy header band. Title text and axis labels in dark navy #002540; body and label text in category colours (blue #419AD9, dark blue #1D5A85, pink #FF6699, plum #5F265F, lilac #AE90AE, green #489B48); bar fills light warm grey #D9D7D1 with no visible outline. Title is a light-to-regular geometric grotesque-style serif-free display face (SeasonMix Regular), roughly 5.9% of slide height. Band label and zone headings in SeasonSans, bold for the band and chart labels, regular for the zone headings; chart labels about 1.7% of slide height, zone headings about 2.2%, axis titles bold about 2.2%. Pill bars have fully rounded ends (stadium shape) and a thin lighter edge; no shadows or gradients. Lines are dark navy #002540, about 0.4% of slide height thick, with solid triangular arrowheads.

**Layout**

Three equal columns sit inside a single thin-ruled rectangular frame spanning roughly the middle of the slide, with the title centred above it in the upper area. Each column holds an icon at top-left with a bold blue heading and regular navy text below, left-aligned. The footer URL and page number sit at bottom right, with a short dash between them.

**Visuals**

Three outline line icons in dark navy #002540, stroke about 0.3% of slide height, drawn at the top-left of each column. Column 1 (x 7.8, y 36.7, w 7.1, h 10.8): a handshake drawn with angular single-weight lines. Column 2 (x 37.9, y 36.7, w 7.6, h 10.8): a network diagram of a central open circle with three connecting lines to three hollow squares (one upper-left, one upper-right, one lower-right) and one line to a square on the left; the circle sits at the centre with lines radiating outward. Column 3 (x 68.2, y 36.7, w 6.1, h 10.8): a puzzle piece outline with tabs on the top, right and bottom and a notch on the left. No photographs, charts or tables. **Visuals**

Venn diagram of two overlapping filled circles of equal size (each about 17.6% of slide width and 31.4% of slide height). The left circle is solid dark blue #1D5A85 and the right circle is medium green #489B48 at 78% opacity, so the lens-shaped overlap renders as a darker green. Inside the overlap sits white text reading ~21% in bold sans with a small 'of top clients overlap' caption beneath. A thin navy vertical leader line drops from the bottom of the overlap lens (about 50% across) to just below the circles, pointing to the caption 'Deepening existing relationships'. Two thin navy horizontal lines extend from the left text block to the left circle and from the right circle to the right text block, both at about 50% of slide height. No photographs, logos or icons. No chart axes or legend; the only printed value is ~21%, with no series data.

Headings 'Brookfield clients' and 'Oaktree clients' are bold geometric sans (SeasonSans-Bold style) in navy #002540 at about 5.9% of slide height. Sub-labels 'Cross-sell runway' are regular-weight sans in navy #002540 at about 3.7%. The central caption 'Deepening existing relationships' is bold sans navy #002540 at about 4.4%. Inside the circle the '21' is bold sans white #FFFFFF at about 8.9%, the '~' and '%' are bold white at about 4.4%, and 'of top clients overlap' is regular white at about 2.6%. The navy band #002540 carries bold sans text in pale blue #B3D7F0 at about 3.7%. Footer is regular sans navy #002540 at about 1.1%, letterspaced capitals for the URL. Lines are navy #002540, roughly 1.5 px hairlines, square-ended, no corner radius, no shadows, no gradients. The navy band is a sharp rectangle with square corners and no shadow.

**Layout**

A centred title sits across the top of the slide in one line, with a large circular sunburst chart centred below it occupying most of the lower two-thirds. The chart has three concentric rings: a small white centre disc, an inner ring of four-segment category labels, and an outer ring of sub-segments, with the Infrastructure and Energy sectors on the right, Credit at upper left, Real Estate at left, and Private Equity and social/infrastructure segments at bottom. A small footer sits bottom right with the website, a short horizontal rule and the page number 87, all on a single baseline.

**Visuals**

One sunburst (radial pie) diagram with two rings of segments around a white centre disc, separated by thin white gaps. Outer ring segments and their labels, clockwise from top: blue (#1D5A85) Infrastructure sub-segments Transportation, Distribution, Rail & Ports, Toll Roads, Pipelines, LNG & Storage, Data Centers, Fiber & Towers; green (#489B48) Energy sub-segments Run-of-River, Pumped Storage, Utility-Scale Solar, Distributed Solar, Onshore Wind, Offshore Wind, Battery Storage, Nuclear; light green (#ADD2AD) Private Equity sub-segments Social Infrastructure, Fuel Distribution, Low-Voltage Batteries, Distribution, Heat-Tracing Systems, Financial Infrastructure, Outsourced Services, Vertical Software, Data & Analytics; dark purple (#5F265F) Real Estate sub-segments Multifamily, Student & Senior, Office & Life Science, Logistics & Industrial, Luxury & Resort, Select Service, Regional Malls, Open-Air Retail; lilac (#BFA8BF) Credit sub-segments High Yield & CLOs, Direct Lending, Special Situations, Distressed Debt, Infrastructure Debt, Real Estate Debt, Equipment Finance, Aviation Finance. Inner ring segments: Infrastructure (blue) with Utilities, Transport, Midstream, Data; Energy (green) with Hydro, Solar, Wind, Other Energy Solutions; Private Equity (light green) with Technology Services, Business Services, Industrials, Infrastructure Services; Real Estate (purple) with Retail, Hospitality, Commercial, Housing; Credit (lilac) with Corporate Credit, Opportunistic Credit, Real Asset Finance, Asset-Backed Finance. Centre disc labels: Infrastructure, Energy, Private Equity, Real Estate, Credit are placed in the middle ring at the points of their sectors. No axes, no legend, no highlighted points. Line-style icons in dark navy (#0F3557) sit inside the inner ring for each sector: a transmission tower and a truck in Infrastructure, a briefcase and a building in Real Estate, a house and a hand with coins in Credit, a leaf, a sun and a drop in Energy, a briefcase and a battery in Private Equity, a shopping bag, a hotel and an apartment building in Real Estate. Small line icons also mark Corporate Credit (briefcase), Real Asset Finance (house in circle) and Midstream (tank). Footer rule is a thin navy line.

**Design**

Background is a warm off-white #F2F1EF with no gradient or pattern. Title is set in a light-to-regular geometric grotesque sans-serif in dark navy #002540, roughly 5.9 percent of slide height for the cap height region, regular weight. Chart labels are a bold geometric sans-serif (SeasonSans Bold style) in dark navy #002540 on light fills and white #FFFFFF on dark fills; sector labels use #0F3557 on the lilac and light green centres. Footer text is a regular-weight sans-serif in #002540 at about 1.1 percent of slide height, letter-spaced capitals. Segment fills: blue #1D5A85, green #489B48, light green #ADD2AD, purple #5F265F, lilac #BFA8BF. Segments separated by thin light lines of the background colour; a white ring of about 0.5 percent width separates the rings. No corner radii, shadows or gradients.

Y-axis: 'Investment required ($ trillions)', linear, range 0 to 9, gridlines and tick labels at every 1 (0 to 9). X-axis: years 2007 to 2040, labelled every three years (2007, 2010, 2013, 2016, 2019, 2022, 2025, 2028, 2031, 2034, 2037, 2040); data appears annual. Series 1, 'Current', is the bottom blue band (#1D5A85). Series 2, 'Funding Gap', is the top green band (#489B48) stacked on Current. No data labels are printed; the following values are estimates: 2007 Current about 1.8, total about 3.6; 2010 Current about 2.1, total about 4.2; 2016 Current about 2.5, total about 5.3; 2022 Current about 2.8, total about 6.1; 2028 Current about 3.2, total about 6.9; 2034 Current about 3.5, total about 7.6; 2040 Current about 3.8, total about 8.4. Funding Gap is therefore about 1.8 at 2007 and about 4.6 at 2040. No legend box; the series are identified by right-side brackets labelled 'Funding Gap' (green bracket spanning about 3.8 to 8.4) and 'Current' (blue bracket spanning 0 to about 3.8). No highlighted points. Three grey rectangles below the x-axis carry phase labels: 'Digitalization' (under about 2007 to 2016), 'Decarbonization' (under about 2019 to 2028) and 'Deglobalization' (under about 2031 to 2040).

**Design**

Background off-white #F2F1EF with no gradient, texture or image. Title in SeasonMix-Regular, a light-weight display serif with a high-contrast transitional look, navy #002540, roughly 5.9% of slide height, sentence case, centred. Chart subtitle and axis, legend and phase labels in SeasonSans, a geometric grotesque sans; bold for the subtitle, axis title, series labels, phase labels and x-axis years; regular for y-axis ticks; navy #002540, about 2.2% for labels and 1.8% for tick and axis text. Series colours: Current #1D5A85 (deep blue), Funding Gap #489B48 (green). Gridlines are thin light grey lines. Phase label boxes are flat #D9D7D1 rectangles with square corners and no shadow, text centred in navy bold. Source line in SeasonSans italic-accented, black #000000, about 1.5%. Footer text is SeasonSans regular, navy, about 1.1%, uppercase with letter-spacing. Brackets are thin 1 pt-style lines, green and blue, with short end ticks.

**Layout**

Two-panel layout on a full-slide light grey field: a single-line title spans the top across the full width, left-aligned at about 5.8% of slide width with the title baseline near 17% of the height. Below it, a grouped bar chart fills the left half (x 9.5 to 42%) and a line chart fills the right half (x 51 to 94%), separated by a vertical navy rule at about x 46% with a circled plus sign at its midpoint. Source lines sit bottom-left at x 4.7%, y 86 to 89%, and the footer 'BROOKFIELD.COM — 96' sits bottom-right at y 92.4%, right-aligned to about x 95%. Margins are roughly 5% left and right.

**Visuals**

Chart 1: grouped vertical bar chart titled 'U.S Commercial Real Estate Volume YoY ($B)'. Categories on the x-axis: H1 2025 and H1 2026. Two series: CRE Debt Originations (dark blue #1D5A85) and CRE Transactions (green #489B48). Printed values: H1 2025 CRE Debt Originations $363B, CRE Transactions $224B; H1 2026 CRE Debt Originations $453B, CRE Transactions $294B. Bars are drawn to scale with a horizontal baseline in navy; no y-axis or gridlines are shown. Legend sits above the chart, centred, with a blue square before CRE Debt Originations and a green square before CRE Transactions. Two light grey (#D6D5D0) straight arrows with arrowheads run diagonally upward across the bars: one from the H1 2025 debt bar top area to the H1 2026 debt bar top, labelled by a grey circle reading +25%; a second from the lower H1 2025 transaction bar area up to the H1 2026 green bar top, labelled by a grey circle reading +31%. Chart 2: line chart titled 'Real Estate Valuations (CPPI Index)'. Y-axis 115 to 160 in steps of 5, unitless index values, labels at left. X-axis years 2020 to 2026 labelled at the baseline. One dark blue (#1D5A85) line about 3 pixels thick. Values about: starts near 135 in early 2020, dips to about 120 in mid-2020, rises to about 155 around late 2021 and early 2022 (peak), declines to about 121 around early 2024, then rises to about 133 by mid-2026. Two light grey dashed vertical lines mark the start of 2022 and about early 2024 and separate three phases labelled Sharp appreciation, Correction and Stabilization / recovery. Grey rounded bubbles mark -22% in the Correction phase (about 2023) and +9% near 2026. A navy circled plus symbol (light blue #419AD9 plus inside a navy ring) sits on a vertical navy bar between the two charts.

**Design**

Background: Solid off-white light grey #F2F1EF.

**Layout**

Centred two-line title across the top, with a three-column stat panel below it, three full-width checkmark bullet lines beneath that, then a row of six equal grey tiles with captions, a small source line at lower left and a footer at lower right with the brand name and slide number. Left margin of content is about 4.5% of slide width and right margin about 4%. The title is centred on the slide. Stat text and bullets are left-aligned to the inner panel edges.

**Visuals**

Six line icons sitting above the tile captions, one per tile, drawn in dark navy #002540 thin strokes with blue #419AD9 accents: (1) Specialized mortgages: a small house outline with a square window and a tall office building with a grid of small blue windows beside it. (2) Music IP royalties: a beamed pair of eighth notes with two small open note heads at the bottom. (3) Equipment finance: a forklift-style machine outline with a blue vertical mast and a blue horizontal base line at right. (4) Aviation finance: a side-view airplane outline in navy with a short blue horizontal underline beneath it. (5) Fund finance: a hand palm-up in navy outline with a blue dollar sign above it. (6) Consumer & SME credit: a globe outline with continents drawn in navy. Three navy checkmark icons (thin single-stroke ticks) precede the three bullet lines. A thin grey outlined rectangle frames the three stat cells, with two thin vertical grey divider lines separating them. A short navy horizontal line sits at lower right beside the footer text, to the left of the slide number.

**Design**

Background warm off-white #F2F1EF with no gradient or texture. Title in SeasonMix-Regular (a light-to-regular humanist serif-like grotesk, serif-influenced), navy #002540, sentence case, about 5.9% of slide height, centred. Stat numbers in SeasonSans-Bold, blue #419AD9, about 12.2% of slide height, with the $ and B unit characters at about 5.9%. Stat labels in SeasonSans-Regular, navy #002540, about 3.7% of slide height. Bullet text in SeasonSans-Regular navy #002540, about 3.7% of slide height. Tile captions in SeasonSans-Regular navy #002540, about 1.8%. Source line in SeasonSans-Regular, black #000000, about 1.5%. Footer in SeasonSans-Regular, navy #002540, widely letter-spaced capitals for BROOKFIELD.COM, about 1.1%. Tiles are flat fill #D9D7D1 with no border, square corners, no shadow. Stat panel has thin light grey hairline borders, square corners, no fill. Checkmarks are thin navy strokes with no fill.

Series, one bar per period with printed values: 2021 $33; 2022 $299; 2023 $225; 2024 $166; Mar-25 $117; Jun-25 $167; Sep-25 $162; Dec-25 $202; Mar-26 $284. Bars are dark blue #1D5A85 except Mar-26, which is green #489B48 and highlights the latest value. Overlaid on the chart are three light blue #419AD9 circular bubbles: a bubble on the 2021 bar reads $15, a bubble above the Mar-26 bar reads $166, and the bubble sizes are not scaled to values. A light grey #D9D7D1 circle sits between the 2024 and Dec-25 bars and carries the text +11x. A thin light grey #D9D7D1 arrow runs diagonally from the $15 bubble, passing over the bars, to the $166 bubble, with its arrowhead pointing at the $166 bubble. Legend: none. Highlighted points: the Mar-26 bar in green, and the $15 and $166 bubbles. Source line: Source: Oaktree internal disclosure.

**Layout**

Single open canvas with no grid or columns. The title is centred horizontally near the top (x 22.9 to 77.1 percent, y 8.7 percent). Left column holds two stacked icon-and-label pairs (icons at about x 4.5 percent, labels left-aligned at x 4.7 percent) with a double-chevron arrow and a left-aligned body paragraph at x 22.9 percent beside them. A large blue circle sits at the upper right, overlapping a rising area chart that runs across the lower half to a right-hand arrow column of labels at x 87 percent. Footer at bottom right with a short rule and the page number.

**Visuals**

Line-and-area graphic with no axis labels or values printed. Type: rising growth diagram. Series 1 is a solid green (#4A9E4A) curve with a green arrowhead at the right end, labelled Financing demand. Series 2 is a dashed dark navy (#002540) curve with a navy arrowhead at the right end, labelled Traditional sources of capital. The region between the two curves is filled with pale green #ADD2AD at 50 percent opacity and is labelled Private credit runway. The curves start at a small open navy circle at the lower-left origin, about x 4.2 percent y 95 percent. The green curve rises to about y 59 percent at its arrow tip; the navy dashed curve rises only to about y 90 percent. No numeric values are printed. Icon 1: a line-drawn oak leaf in navy #002540, above the label Real assets credit. Icon 2: a line-drawn office building with a blue (#4A9BD6) window grid and a navy shield overlapping its lower-right corner, above the label Asset-backed finance. Icon 3: a navy double chevron pointing right between the left column and the body text. Large blue circle #1D5A85 contains the white text Trillions and its caption; the circle overlaps the top of the green curve and arrow.

**Design**

Background: Solid warm off-white #F2F1EF covering the whole slide. Warm off-white background #F2F1EF with no gradient or texture. Title in a light-weight high-contrast serif (SeasonMix Regular, similar to a transitional display serif), navy #002540, about 5.9 percent of slide height for the cap-height line. Body and labels in SeasonSans Regular or Bold, navy #002540; the bold labels are about 2.6 percent. Body paragraph about 3.0 percent. Inside the circle, Trillions is SeasonSans Bold white #FFFFFF at about 8.0 percent and the caption is SeasonSans Regular white at about 3.7 percent. Private credit runway is SeasonSans Bold navy at about 3.7 percent. Accent colours: blue circle #1D5A85, green #4A9E4A, pale green #ADD2AD at 50 percent opacity, light blue #4A9BD6 in icon detail. Lines are about 0.6 percent of slide height thick for the green curve and about 0.4 percent for the dashed navy curve. No shadows, no rounded corners on the circle (true circle), arrowheads are solid triangles.
